library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(randomForest)
library(tibble)






# 6.1. Import Data for RF


data_dir    <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"

patient_info_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "patient_info_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"), 
  stringsAsFactors=F, row.names=1, check.names=F)

ntrees <- as.numeric(Parameters["RF Trees", "Count"])

patient_info_with_folds$patient_id <- as.character(patient_info_with_folds$patient_id)

lasso_fold_coefs    <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"),    stringsAsFactors=F)
lasso_fold_coefs_n3 <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n3.csv"), stringsAsFactors=F)
lasso_fold_coefs_n1 <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n1.csv"), stringsAsFactors=F)

y <- as.factor(patient_info_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication)
patient_info_with_folds <- as.data.frame(patient_info_with_folds)






# 6.2. RF function


lassoRF_cv_outer_fold <- function(test_fold, selected_lasso_coefs) {
  set.seed(8634782 + test_fold)

  keep <- selected_lasso_coefs %>%
    filter(fold == test_fold) %>%
    .$protein

  X <- protein_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]

  train <- patient_info_with_folds$fold != test_fold

  rf <- randomForest(X[train, , drop = FALSE], y[train], ntree = ntrees)

  preds <- predict(rf, newdata = X[!train, , drop = FALSE], type = "prob")[, "Definite"]

  list(test_fold = test_fold, mod = rf, pred = preds)
}






# 6.3. Helper to collect predictions


collect_preds <- function(cv_list) {
  cv_list %>%
    lapply(function(x) {
      data.frame(
        patient_id = rownames(protein_mat)[patient_info_with_folds$fold == x$test_fold],
        pred       = x$pred
      )
    }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      dplyr::select(patient_info_with_folds, patient_id, LRTI_adjudication),
      by = "patient_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(LRTI_adjudication, .after = patient_id)
}






# 6.4. Run RF for all 5 classifiers


max_fold <- max(patient_info_with_folds$fold)


# lambda.1se (full LASSO)
cv_lambda <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_fold_coefs))
rf_preds_lambda <- collect_preds(cv_lambda)
write.csv(rf_preds_lambda, file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds.csv"), row.names=F)
message("lambda.1se done — n = ", nrow(rf_preds_lambda))


# n3
cv_n3 <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_fold_coefs_n3))
rf_preds_n3 <- collect_preds(cv_n3)
write.csv(rf_preds_n3, file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_n3.csv"), row.names=F)
message("n3 done — n = ", nrow(rf_preds_n3))


# n1
cv_n1 <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_fold_coefs_n1))
rf_preds_n1 <- collect_preds(cv_n1)
write.csv(rf_preds_n1, file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_n1.csv"), row.names=F)
message("n1 done — n = ", nrow(rf_preds_n1))


# FABP4 single biomarker
lasso_coefs_FABP4 <- data.frame(
  protein = rep("FABP4", max_fold),
  coef    = NA,
  fold    = 1:max_fold
)
cv_FABP4 <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_coefs_FABP4))
rf_preds_FABP4 <- collect_preds(cv_FABP4)
write.csv(rf_preds_FABP4, file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_FABP4.csv"), row.names=F)
message("FABP4 done — n = ", nrow(rf_preds_FABP4))


# ISG15 single biomarker
lasso_coefs_ISG15 <- data.frame(
  protein = rep("ISG15", max_fold),
  coef    = NA,
  fold    = 1:max_fold
)
cv_ISG15 <- lapply(1:max_fold, function(f) lassoRF_cv_outer_fold(f, lasso_coefs_ISG15))
rf_preds_ISG15 <- collect_preds(cv_ISG15)
write.csv(rf_preds_ISG15, file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_ISG15.csv"), row.names=F)
message("ISG15 done — n = ", nrow(rf_preds_ISG15))






# 6.5. Safety Checks


all(lasso_fold_coefs$protein    %in% colnames(protein_mat))
all(lasso_fold_coefs_n3$protein %in% colnames(protein_mat))
all(lasso_fold_coefs_n1$protein %in% colnames(protein_mat))
nrow(rf_preds_lambda) == nrow(patient_info_with_folds)
all(rownames(protein_mat) == patient_info_with_folds$patient_id)
